notes_for_editor: County corrected from 'Idaho' to 'Idaho County' per firelookout.com. Elevation 6,084 ft appears on two pages but is not a schema key, so it is only in the story. Height is the stated 50-foot tower converted to metres; the sources do not say whether that is measured to the cab floor. The 2010 Forest Service list has a '+/-' mark on the Sable Hill row that the text extraction does not explain. Only one staffer is named. No source describes the site today; the hike-in label is the only access detail.
